gold: Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement

selector.rationale: Facial nerve schwannoma best explains the patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including the nonpulsatile mass protruding through the inferior ear canal and the expansion of the fallopian canal distal to the second genu of the facial nerve

rejected.label: Chondroid syringoma
